entry.title: Torre Moeve
entry.note: Exact-QID cross-shaped envelope and independent east/west cores retain their signed axis. The original engineer plan puts full-height cores east/west and broad office fronts north/south, confirming the mapped phase. GroundY0 is the lobby entrance datum. Published53x42.5m plan supersedes submeter map tracing variation; the mapped upper office datums are not accepted over primary construction elevations. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
